# TimeDown

> TimeDown is a simple, clean, and elegant countdown timer app for iOS and Android. Count the days to the moments that matter—birthdays, vacations, weddings, anniversaries, exams, holidays, and milestones. Zero clutter, live updates, and all your events in one beautiful list.

## Key Facts
- **Developer:** Designed and developed by Srikanth Nandiraju ([Twitter / X @nandiraju](https://twitter.com/nandiraju))
- **Price:** Free
- **Platform:** iOS (iPhone & iPad via Apple App Store, ID: 1644886404) and Android (Google Play: nsri.countdown.app)
- **App Store Link:** [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/timedown-counttminus/id1644886404](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/timedown-counttminus/id1644886404)
- **Google Play Link:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nsri.countdown.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nsri.countdown.app)
- **Privacy Architecture:** 100% on-device local privacy, no account required, no sign-up, zero third-party ads
- **Design Philosophy:** Minimalist, high-contrast dark design optimized for quick glancing and focus
- **Event Capacity:** Track unlimited event countdowns

## Core Functionality
- **How It Works:**
  1. Tap `+` to create a countdown in seconds.
  2. Give your event a name, a personal note, and a target date.
  3. View every upcoming event in one unified list with exact days and time remaining.
- **Why TimeDown:**
  - Simple: No clutter, just your events and the days left.
  - Clean dark aesthetic: High contrast typography and AMOLED-friendly dark palette.
  - Real-time updates: Live counter showing days, hours, and minutes.
  - Multi-event tracking: Create and manage as many countdowns as you need.
- **Popular Use Cases:**
  - Birthday countdowns
  - Vacation and travel countdowns
  - Wedding day counter
  - Anniversary reminders
  - Exam and academic deadline tracking
  - Holiday and festival anticipation
  - Baby due date tracking
  - Retirement milestones
